Responsibility.Value: Defines units, facts with origins, anchors, IDs, relations, evidence and edges, and validates them: why-fields are never EXTRACTED, a USER_STATED fact carries a source, only contracts carry a signature, and only known relation kinds join known unit kinds.

Units.Name: unit kind directories
Units.Sentence: which .abbd folder holds each kind's unit files; store keeps its own copy of the folder list and status its own list of kinds

Units.Name: unit absent flag
Units.Sentence: a unit the script no longer reports or whose evidence died is kept but absent; identity, evidence and the group fallback each write it, in the order sync runs them, and every reader filters on it

Units.Name: evidence line range text
Units.Sentence: the N or N-M form of an evidence item's lines; model parses it, evidence writes it back on every sync, and topology strips it from a query

Units.Name: citable evidence paths
Units.Sentence: evidence may not cite .abbd/ or .git/; the rule lives only in model, while evidence moves quotes among the files gitx lists, which include .abbd/

Units.Name: unit ID format
Units.Sentence: IDs are a kind prefix, a dash and at least four digits, such as MOD-0001; FormatID writes them and ParseID reads the kind back.

Units.Name: evidence citation
Units.Sentence: An evidence item is a path, optional lines such as 120 or 120-134, optional symbol and a verbatim quote, written PATH:LINES:QUOTE on the command line, and may not cite .abbd or .git files.

Units.Name: guess versus topology rule
Units.Sentence: A unit is semantic when its name is INFERRED; a relation counts as topology only when it is live and EXTRACTED or USER_STATED, and is a guess when INFERRED.

Units.Name: relation grammar
Units.Sentence: The table of which unit kinds each relation kind may join (a module or feature provides a contract, anything consumes a contract, anything depends_on any unit) and the list of allowed via values.

Units.Name: fact origins
Units.Sentence: Defines the EXTRACTED, INFERRED and USER_STATED origins and enforces that a why-field is never EXTRACTED and that exactly the USER_STATED facts carry a source.

Stacks.Question: What are the layers of the abbd CLI?

Purpose.Value: so every command reads and writes the .abbd directory through one place that keeps its files stable and diffable

Responsibility.Value: Owns the on-disk layout of .abbd: unit Markdown files, candidates, state, project config, module understandings and blueprint files, plus the fingerprints that tell when derived views are stale.

Units.Name: merge candidates file
Units.Sentence: Persists .abbd/candidates.yaml as a list of new, existing and shared-anchor entries, written empty rather than absent, and pruned to live IDs on each sync.

Units.Name: unit notes section
Units.Sentence: Splits a unit file's body at the '## Notes' heading on read and appends it unchanged after the generated title and anchor list on write; everything above it is regenerated.

Units.Name: ID high-water mark
Units.Sentence: the last number minted per kind, kept in state.yaml so a number never returns; identity, the group fallback and abbd record unit each mint from it

Units.Name: store staleness hashes
Units.Sentence: Hashes sorted file sets as relative path, length and bytes: MDHash over unit files for state, InputsHash over every .abbd file except the blueprint for the blueprint watermark.

Units.Name: ID high-water minting
Units.Sentence: Mints the next ID of a kind for a hand-recorded unit by bumping the per-kind high-water in state.yaml and saving it.

Units.Name: units at a revision
Units.Sentence: Reads and parses the committed unit files under .abbd/architecture and .abbd/features at a revision through git, treating a revision without .abbd as having no units.

Units.Name: no-op-aware atomic write
Units.Sentence: Every store write skips a file whose bytes are already equal and otherwise writes a .tmp sibling and renames it into place.

Units.Name: module code digest
Units.Sentence: Fingerprints, CRLF-normalized and truncated to 16 hex, every file cited by the anchors and evidence of a present module and its child units, counting a missing file as missing.

Stacks.Question: What are the layers of the abbd CLI?

Purpose.Value: so the CLI can answer questions about the stored topology without each command walking units and relations itself

Responsibility.Value: Answers read-only queries over stored units: one unit at a glance, the strongest shortest path between two units, what a change to some units reaches, and how the topology differs between two revisions.

Units.Name: diff report fields
Units.Sentence: Fixes the JSON field names of the diff (units_added, units_removed, contract_signatures_changed, contract_code_changed, relations_added, relations_removed, inferred_added) that abbd diff --json prints.

Units.Name: top-level unit rule
Units.Sentence: a unit is top level when it has no parent; the screen also lifts a unit whose parent is absent, while diff, understand and explain test the Parent field alone

Units.Name: origin strength order
Units.Sentence: EXTRACTED beats USER_STATED beats INFERRED; topology ranks paths by it, the screen picks a wire's origin with its own copy, identity keeps the extracted copy of a repeated edge

Units.Name: contract code digest
Units.Sentence: the extraction script's digest of a contract's code; identity carries it, bootstrap clears it for a reader's unit, and diff reads an empty digest as unknown and a changed one as code changed under the same signature

Units.Name: contract provider rule
Units.Sentence: which module provides a contract; topology counts only a provides relation, while the screen also counts the module a contract sits inside

Units.Name: boundary rule
Units.Sentence: Decides that a diff reaches the boundary when a contract's signature changed, a contract was added or removed, or a drawn relation between top-level units appeared or went; a contract's code change under the same signature does not count.

Units.Name: topology diff
Units.Sentence: Compares two unit sets into sorted categories: units added and removed, contract signatures changed, contract code changed under the same signature, drawn relations between top-level units (an inside unit's relation lifted to its module), and reader couplings added.

Units.Name: impact walk
Units.Sentence: Walks from the seeds (and units inside seed modules) to dependents, consumers, contract providers and provided contracts, marks what the seeds use without following it, and splits the result into a direct and a far tier.

Units.Name: live links
Units.Sentence: Lists every relation between present units that is not dead, extracted, stated or inferred, with its origin, via and evidence, and labels each with where it comes from.

Units.Name: unit explanation
Units.Sentence: Gathers one present unit, the units inside it, its drawn links out and in (counting an inside unit's link across the boundary as the unit's own), and the reader couplings touching it or anything inside it.

Units.Name: strongest shortest path
Units.Sentence: Finds the shortest undirected walk over live links and, among equally short walks, the one whose weakest hop is strongest by the order extracted over stated over inferred, and reports that weakest origin.
